title: Zimbardo's Stanford Prison Experiment

tellings.quote: And Philip Zimbardo at Stanford with the Stanford Prison Experiment, like all very similar.

plain: Michels brings up the Stanford Prison Experiment, a 1971 study at Stanford run by the psychologist Philip Zimbardo in which volunteers were cast as prison guards and prisoners, and calls it "all very similar" to other research he is discussing. He says it himself, in an episode about a secret society he links to the UFO cover-up, and does not spell out what the similarity is.
